subject: Discovery recap: Reliability & graceful degradation (ACME Corp)
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwoodinference.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-08-25T14:10:00-07:00
Subject: Discovery recap: Reliability & graceful degradation (ACME Corp)

Sarah — great to meet you and Tom earlier. Quick recap from our call and proposed next steps so we’re aligned.

Key pain points you shared:
- Recent incidents: two production outages in Q2 where model endpoints experienced 5–10x request spikes and full-throttle queuing; affected critical customer journeys for ~45 minutes.
- Lack of graceful degradation: fallback logic is currently app-side and results in 500s when the primary endpoint drops.
- Observability gaps: need per-route latency and token-level cost breakdown, and clearer audit logs for requests tied to customer IDs.

Current stack:
- Frontend app -> in-house API gateway -> third-party LLM endpoints (auto-scaling)
- No dedicated GPU pool today; all requests go to shared managed endpoints

Success criteria you mentioned:
1) 99.9% availability for inference on peak traffic days (SLO target)
2) Automatic fallback to lower-cost/compatibly-capable model variants or region without user-visible errors
3) Tracing + token-cost visibility per request + audit logs retained for 90 days

What Redwood can do / proposed approach:
- Smart routing: route by latency/cost/region with automatic fallback to warmed model variants and regional pools.
- Graceful degradation: built-in fallback policies (model variant downgrade, region failover, or limited-response mode) so app receives partial or truncated responses instead of 500s.
- Caching & batching: prefix/KV caching and request-aware batching to reduce hot-path token load during spikes.
- Observability: per-route dashboards, token-level cost breakdown, and audit logs with 90-day retention (enterprise plan).

Attachments included: acme-map-20260825.pdf (mutual action plan draft) and rdw-sla-draft-acme-20260825.docx (SLA draft with proposed SLOs/fallbacks).

Proposed next steps (please confirm availability):
- Technical deep-dive with Marissa (solutions/infra) this week — 45 minutes to go through incident timeline, payload patterns, and sample traces. (Requested: Thu 8/27 10am PT or Fri 8/28 11am PT)
- Share incident logs/summary (anonymized) from your Q2 outages so we can simulate and size dedicated pool + fallback configs.
- Draft a scoped pilot: 4-week dedicated capacity trial with canary routing and automated fallback; review success metrics at week 2 and week 4.
- Procurement: we’ll hand off terms and the SLA draft to Neha once you confirm pilot scope.

If helpful, I can attach a short runbook showing how graceful degradation behaves across three failure modes (model overload, region outage, KV cache miss).

Thanks again — looking forward to next steps.

Best,
Ben Carter
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwoodinference.com | (415) 555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Jensen <sarah.jensen@acmecorp.com>

Date: 2026-08-25T15:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery recap: Reliability & graceful degradation (ACME Corp)

Thanks Ben — that was a helpful summary. A few clarifications and requests from our side: 

1) The outages were caused by a burst from a marketing campaign (unexpected pattern) and a separate bug that amplified request fan-out. Total customer impact ~45m and ~30m respectively. We retained traces in-house but can share anonymized request logs.
2) For graceful degradation we prefer a hierarchy: 1) warm lighter-weight model variant in-region, 2) if not available then region failover to nearest warm pool, 3) last resort the app receives a short prefilled response (e.g., "We’re experiencing high load — here’s a summary").
3) SLO targets: we want to target 99.95% for the most critical route and 99.9% for other inference routes. Need to understand tradeoffs on cost and latency with those SLOs.

We can do the technical deep-dive on Thu 8/27 10am PT — Tom will join from infra. I’ll upload the anonymized traces to the shared Drive link you included.

Also please include an initial cost estimate for a 4-week dedicated pilot (GPU type assumptions & expected token volumes).

-Sarah
Director of Product, ACME Corp
sarah.jensen@acmecorp.com
